desc_lamps: Light with presence. Refined silhouettes that shape the atmosphere of a room.

product_intro: An expressive silhouette, a thoughtful balance of texture and proportion. A piece that gives everyday spaces a distinctive point of view.
care_body: Dust gently with a soft, dry cloth. Keep away from prolonged direct sunlight and moisture. Use protective mats beneath objects on wood surfaces.

material_title:
No two grains.
No two stories.
material_body: Materials, finishes and care information are listed on individual product pages.
not_found_body: We couldn’t find this page. Find something considered in our collection.
oak_intro: Every Metal Craft piece begins with Bulgarian oak over 100 years old. A material with a life before us, and a future with you.
oak_grain_body: Look closely. Tight growth rings reveal the wood’s distinctive, dense grain. We select aged oak for its durability and structural stability, giving every piece substance you can feel.
oak_grain_detail: Its value starts beneath the surface.
oak_patina_title: A colour only time can tell.
oak_patina_body: Over time, oak develops a rich, darkened patina. Variations in tone, grain and texture become a record of a life already lived. This is the warmth and depth we bring into a Metal Craft piece.
oak_patina_detail: Time gives the surface its own depth.
oak_life_title: An old soul. A new home.
oak_life_body: Aged oak can come from reclaimed barn beams or heritage trees. What remains is strong timber with a story worth keeping. Metal Craft shapes this character into furniture for another chapter.
oak_life_caption: Wood, shaped for a new chapter
